title: Genesis 3:10-12 — “I was afraid because I was naked”; the man blames the woman
summary: Genesis 3:10-12 in English: the man says he hid because he was afraid and naked; God asks who told him he was naked and whether he ate from the tree he was commanded not to eat from; the man blames the woman God gave him. The word “tree” is highlighted in brown.

text.text: 10 He said, “I heard the sound of You in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
11 And He said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”
12 The man said, “The woman whom You gave to be with me, she gave me from the tree, and I ate.”
